adam-adlb-supplb-padded-key.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADLB
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ]
input:
  LB: {path: input/lb.csv, types: {LBSEQ: int}}
  SUPPLB: input/supplb.csv

output:
  path: adlb.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ, QVAL, QVAL_NAMED]

intermediates:
  - id: SUP_EP
    dataset: SUPPLB
    key:
      STUDYID: LB.STUDYID
      USUBJID: LB.USUBJID
      IDVARVAL: {str_pad: {source: LBSEQ, width: 8}}
    no_match: null

columns:
  - {name: STUDYID, type: str, label: Study Identifier, derivation: LB.STUDYID}

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Subject Identifier
    derivation: LB.USUBJID

  - {name: LBSEQ, type: int, label: Sequence Number, derivation: LB.LBSEQ}
  - {name: QVAL, type: str, label: Supplemental Value}

  - name: QVAL_NAMED
    type: str
    label: Supplemental Value by Named Intermediate
    derivation: SUP_EP.QVAL

rows:
  - id: low_sequence
    dataset: LB
    filter: "LB.LBSEQ < 200"
    derivations: {QVAL: SUP_EP.QVAL}

  - id: high_sequence
    dataset: LB
    filter: "LB.LBSEQ >= 200"
    derivations: {QVAL: SUP_EP.QVAL}

verifications:
  - row_count:
      min: 6
      max: 6

adam-adlb-end-of-treatment.specification:
schema_version: "1.0"
domain: ADLB
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ]
input:
  LB: {path: input/lb.csv, types: {LBSEQ: int, VISITNUM: int, LBSTRESN: float}}
  SUPPLB: input/supplb.csv
base: LB

output:
  path: adlb.csv
  columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ, LBTESTCD, VISITNUM, AVAL, ENDPOINT, EOTFL]

intermediates:
  # The protocol endpoint qualifier, one supplemental record per
  # laboratory record. The supplemental key is the laboratory sequence
  # number written as eight-character, space-padded text.
  - id: SUPP_EP
    dataset: SUPPLB
    key:
      STUDYID: LB.STUDYID
      USUBJID: LB.USUBJID
      IDVARVAL: {str_pad: {source: LB.LBSEQ, width: 8}}
    filter: "SUPPLB.QNAM = 'ENDPOINT'"
    no_match: null
    verifications:
      - unique: [STUDYID, USUBJID, IDVARVAL]

  # Every laboratory record carries its own endpoint qualifier before the
  # window ranks the records of each subject and test: the endpoint
  # record first, then the latest visit.
  - id: EOT_RANK
    dataset: LB
    key: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ]
    derivations:
      ENDPOINT: SUPP_EP.QVAL
      EOT_SEQ:
        row_number:
          window:
            group_by: [LB.USUBJID, LB.LBTESTCD]
            order_by:
              - {variable: ENDPOINT, direction: desc}
              - {variable: LB.VISITNUM, direction: desc}

columns:
  - name: STUDYID
    type: str
    label: Study Identifier
    derivation: LB.STUDYID

  - name: USUBJID
    type: str
    label: Unique Subject Identifier
    derivation: LB.USUBJID

  - name: LBSEQ
    type: int
    label: Sequence Number
    derivation: LB.LBSEQ

  - name: LBTESTCD
    type: str
    label: Lab Test or Examination Short Name
    derivation: LB.LBTESTCD

  - name: VISITNUM
    type: int
    label: Visit Number
    derivation: LB.VISITNUM

  - name: AVAL
    type: float
    label: Analysis Value
    derivation: LB.LBSTRESN

  - name: ENDPOINT
    type: str
    label: Protocol Endpoint Record
    derivation: EOT_RANK.ENDPOINT

  - name: EOTFL
    type: str
    label: End of Treatment Record Flag
    derivation:
      flag: "EOT_RANK.EOT_SEQ = 1"

verifications:
  - unique:
      columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, LBSEQ]
  - row_count:
      min: 12
      max: 12
